outcome: Risk factors for acquiring drug-resistant bacteria
cohort: 1486 bloodstream infection suspected patients at a tertiary care hospital in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia
finding: High percentage of bloodstream infections were caused by  extended-spectrum-beta-lactamase and carbapenemase-producing bacteria, with neonates and patients in specific departments being more susceptible.
mod_finding: Caesarean section delivery was associated with carbapenem-resistant bacterial infection.
